page.layout: One page of text, full width. Below it, the foot shows the catchword "ut" at the right and the signature "K 2" at the centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Persia: velim quae tanti Regni Politiam & Geographiam spectant, descripsisses; hactenus enim admodum obscura sunt hujus regni interiora. Hoc te facturum spero in compendio Historiae Persicae, quod publico spospondisti, fidemque tuam sic praestiturum; finem tandem scribendi faciam, si prius, ut plurimum me ames, Illustrissimam Dominationem tuam instantissime rogaverim; nihil tua amicitia & suavius & honorificentius mihi contingere posse existimo. Vale iterum dico & me ama.
main_text.head: EPIST. XVIII.
Altera ejusdem Argumenti.
main_text.p: Reverendo Patri atque eruditissimo Domino meo Patri Joanni Morino Congrega-gationis Oratorii Presbytero, Petrus à Valle Peregrinis S.P.D.
REverende mi Pater ad calcem Penta-teuchi, disjunctè [?] tamen, & diversa ab aliis magnitudine exaratos versiculos aliquot reperies, verba scriptoris, quibus

page.notes: The right side of the scan carries a dark blurred band and speckling from the neighbouring page or scanner shadow; this is not printed text and is omitted. "disjunctè" is doubtful (marked [?]). "Congrega-gationis" is copied as printed, with the line-end hyphen; it may be a printing error for "Congregationis". Long s is rendered as s throughout. The "ut" in the lower right is the catchword for the next page.
